newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asian, European investors form Asian merchant bank.
newsitem.headline: Asian, European investors form Asian merchant bank.

text.p: Equinox Group Holdings, a firm formed by several major Asian companies and prominent families and two European banks, has started a new Asian merchant bank, the company said on Tuesday.
The bank will focus on principal investments and on providing Asian corporate finance and strategic advisory services, it said.
The two European banks, BHF-BANK of Germany and CCF-Credit Commercial de France, are the principal backers.

Other major shareholders are Asian Financial Group of Hong Kong (the Chan family), China Development Corp of Taiwan, Itochu Capital and Investment (Asia) Ltd and the PSP Group of Indonesia (the Gondokusumo family).
The company has start-up capital of between US$50 and US$100 million, a spokesman for the company said.
In addition to investing its own capital, Equinox intends to sponsor and manage a range of direct investment funds.
In 1997, the company plans to launch a direct investment fund of US$500 million, which it says will be one of Asia's largest.
